title: Enhanced due diligence and escalated onboarding decisions
workflow: Create EDD case from risk, PEP, beneficial-ownership or other approved triggers
Request proportionate additional information under lawful purpose
Validate source documents and record contradictory or missing evidence
Require independent compliance escalation and documented restrictions
Approve, conditionally defer or reject with precise controlled disposition
Set re-review triggers and additional monitoring obligations without bypassing sanctions controls
controls: High-risk onboarding cannot be approved by a single unreviewed automated score
Do not fabricate legal thresholds for source-of-funds or due diligence requirements
Conditional approvals must state which operations remain restricted
Sensitive evidence accessible only to assigned compliance roles with audit
EDD approval does not waive independent identity, sanctions, signing-authority or account eligibility checks
Evidence retention and customer notices must comply with institution's lawful confidentiality restrictions
planned_test_cases: EDD case unresolved blocks ordinary approval where policy requires
Conditional approval cannot activate prohibited payment capability
Investigator cannot self-approve under maker-checker policy
Missing source-of-funds document remains explicit open gap
Re-review trigger produces new immutable case version
review_gate: Reviewed applicable AML/EDD provisions, escalation authority, privacy rules and independent compliance sign-off.
